name: Bitcoin SV Version 1.2.3 Release Notes
body:
Overview
========

The 1.2.3 node release is an important upgrade from version 1.2.2 that contains a number of performance improvements, most notably to initial block download (IBD) and block validation, together with new features and bug fixes.

Important fixes and improvements in 1.2.3
-----------------------------------------

* Improved initial block download (IBD) and block validation performance. The CoinsDB (UTXO) database configuration has been simplified and re-tuned: a larger default file size, a dynamically calculated limit on open files, and a dedicated cache setting. See the configuration section below and the file [ibd-performance.md](ibd-performance.md) for more details.
* TCP socket improvements:
  - The P2P socket loop now waits with poll() instead of select() on Linux and BSD. Windows and macOS remain on select().
  - **-maxconnections** is no longer silently capped near 865 on poll() builds; it is bounded only by the process file descriptor limit. select() builds keep a cap, now about 428 with default settings, since each peer may hold two sockets and all of them must stay below FD_SETSIZE.
  - When the system file descriptor limit is too low for the requested configuration, the coins database file budget (**-maxcoinsdbfiles**) is reduced before the connection count, and startup now fails with a clear error rather than a warning if no connections at all would be possible.
  - Running out of file descriptors on accept() or connect() is now reported in the log at the default level, and a block that cannot be read from disk, whether while answering a filtered block request or while announcing a new block as a compact block, is logged instead of aborting the node.
  - The block index, mempool transaction, merkle tree, frozen TXO, miner ID and dataref databases return to the previous default of 64 open files. Only the coins database uses the large dynamic default, controlled by **-maxcoinsdbfiles**, and only it is reserved for in the file descriptor budget.
* Improved parallelism during block validation by grouping transactions less pessimistically and reducing the default validation batch size.
* Accelerated SHA-256 and merkle root computation using SHA-NI instructions where the CPU supports them.
* Improved block file pruning. Pruning now runs less frequently but more aggressively, and unnecessary expensive coins-cache flushes on the AcceptBlock path have been eliminated.
* Added a new **rescanblockchain** RPC, ported from Bitcoin Core, allowing the wallet to be rescanned over a range of blocks.
* Added optional USDT (userland statically-defined tracing) instrumentation, including RPC and P2P latency tracepoints, enabled at build time with `--enable-usdt`.
* The public libbitcoinconsensus library now exposes the Genesis and Chronicle era flags and SIGHASH_FORKID, so post-Genesis/Chronicle and real (FORKID-signed) BSV inputs can be verified. The API version has been bumped to 2.
* Various bug fixes, including corrected coins-cache memory accounting, a fix in the block download tracker, correct handling of a failed connect at the end of a reorged chain, out-of-range integer handling in OP_SPLIT and deserialization, and fixes for invalid memory access in `CScript` and a use-after-free in the mempool eviction tracker.

Other items
-----------

* Thread-safety hardening, including new mutex wrappers, `GUARDED_BY` annotations, a ThreadSanitizer build, and a fix for a startup null dereference in `FlushStateToDisk`.
* Memory and performance improvements to transaction inventory tracking and the `prevector` container.
* Dead code removal, wallet code refactoring, and general code-quality improvements and hardening.

New or modified configuration options
-------------------------------------

* **-coinsdbcache** is a new option specifying the size of the CoinsDB cache(s). The value is split 1/8 to the underlying LevelDB cache and the remainder to the in-memory CoinsDB cache.
* **-dbcache** no longer affects the CoinsDB cache; it now controls only the block tree and merkle tree index DB caches. Most node operators should no longer need to set it.
* **-maxcoinsprovidercachesize** now defaults to the full size of the CoinsDB memory cache.
* **-maxcoinsdbfiles** default is now calculated dynamically (as close to 8192 as system limits allow) instead of the previous fixed value of 64.
* **-maxcoinsdbfilesize** default has been increased to 128MB.
* **-prunehysteresis** is a new debug option that makes pruning remove block files until disk usage is a given percentage below the target cap, so pruning runs less often but more aggressively.
